topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Lord have mercy, what a tangle the world weaves. My friend, John, always talked of his riches and his high-standing work in the city, but turns out, it was all a sheaf of lies, lighter than chaff. They say the truth is a three-edged knife, and here it cuts deep. I can barely tend to the soil now, mind wandering like a lost lamb. The village buzzes with whispers, and I fear for his soul. What shall I tell his wife and the children, who believed every word? Saints preserve us, what sins lead a man to such deeds? I pray for a clear sky, but the clouds of deceit loom heavy.
